title: C9 has no reachable repair when the earlier claim holder is a dead dev session — and `check-clause2-carriers.mjs:2095` and `SKILL.md:496` prescribe opposite acts for exactly that case
body:
**Class (b)** — two rules in this repository prescribe opposite acts for one state, with both texts quoted. Filed under 「两条细则冲突 ⇒ 按更严的一条行动并立卡」: this seat acted by the stricter one (posted nothing) and is filing rather than settling it in place.

Dedupe words: `C9`, `check-clause2-carriers`, `dead claim`, `Release on the holder's behalf`, `死认领回收`.

## The state, measured on a live card

`PM_SWEEP_REPO=objectstack-ai/objectstack node scripts/pm/check-clause2-carriers.mjs --pair 19373`, run 2026-09-20T16:16Z, **exit 4**, one adverse row:

> ✗ C9 — card #17518 (delivering open PR #19373) — 2 authors hold LIVE claim comments here with no `Release:` from the earlier holder between them — `os-bill`'s 5646971772 at 2026-09-12T15:54:12Z is the claim that stood; `os-litant`'s 5749581295 at 2026-09-20T11:43:41Z took the card from `os-bill` (dated AFTER the effective instant 2026-09-19T03:45Z — JUDGED)

The earlier holder is a **dev subagent session** (`session_01MkQhmuuJAVDjmeWNixwDDH`, named in its own claim line) that ran on 2026-09-12, posted its round's report the same hour, and ended. It cannot post anything. Between then and the retake the card went back through `needs-user-decision` twice and was re-ruled twice.

⚠️ This is not novel on this card. On 2026-09-18 a different seat hit the same row and posted comment 5728328899, headed *"Claim supersession, recorded because the machine reading says the opposite."* — it recorded the state instead of repairing it, because the repair was already unavailable then.

## The two texts, quoted

**`scripts/pm/check-clause2-carriers.mjs:2095`**, inside C9's own repair prose:

> ⛔ never a second `Claim:`, ⛔ never a `Release:` on the holder's behalf.

and, above it, that the repair belongs to *"the seats that hold the claims and ⛔ by nobody else"*, the holder posting `Release:` being *"the one hand-over the protocol sanctions"*.

**`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md:496`**, the last line of 死认领回收:

> 再评论询问,静默一窗后释放回队(`Release:` 行载因);有带提交活分支的认领永不回收。

In the reclamation flow that line sits in, the seat doing the reclaiming is the one that posts, after the silent window — which is a `Release:` on the dead holder's behalf, the act :2095 forbids by name. ⛔ One of the two has to give, and this seat is not the place that decides which.

## Why it does not simply resolve itself

The tool offers exactly two exits from C9 and each is unavailable here:

| exit | why it is unavailable |
|:--|:--|
| the HOLDER posts `Release:` | the holder is a subagent session that ended 2026-09-12 |
| the TAKER posts its own `Release:` with 去向「让先到者」 | the taker has since delivered the card's whole diff — PR #19373, 15 commits, all 35 checks green. Yielding would leave a finished PR held by a dead session |

And the row is deliberately new-only: a taking claim dated at or before **2026-09-19T03:45Z** is listed informational and moves no exit. So the rule was built to bite exactly the hand-overs made from that instant on — which is right — but a card whose earlier holder died *before* that instant can only be taken *after* it, and every such take is permanently JUDGED.

## What it costs, concretely

Pre-landing check ② (`references/contract-review.md`) reads:

> ② 双载体已清,逐对机读 … `--pair N`。0 = 双肢一致、无放宽 tell、head 上有记录;4 = 任一不成立

⇒ a card in this state cannot reach 0, so a strict reading parks its PR forever. The stricter-of-two rule then points at *not landing*, which makes an unrepairable bookkeeping row block finished, green, reviewed work. ⚠️ That consequence is what makes this worth a card rather than a note: the conflict is load-bearing on a landing gate.

## Shape of a fix — suggestions, ⛔ not a ruling

- Give C9 a **third sanctioned exit** for a provably-dead holder, with its own evidence bar (the holder's claim names a session; that session's round reported and the card then left the dev's hands through a documented state change), written as a distinct marker so it is never confused with a holder's own `Release:` — the way `Clause-②-correction:` is distinct from a second `Claim:`.
- Or make C9's judgement follow the CARD's state rather than comment adjacency: a claim whose card has since passed through `needs-user-decision` is not a live claim, and here it did so twice.
- Whichever is chosen, `SKILL.md:496` and the tool's C9 prose ship the change together — 「一条规则在本文与核心条款一处改动,另一处同 PR 同改」.

## Provenance

Measured by this seat while landing PR #19373 (card #17518) on 2026-09-20. Both quoted lines were read first-hand from `origin/main` at `c5d3d1d8b69`; the `C9` token occurs 37 times in the checker (lit control) and `C99ZZZ` 0 times (dark control). Filed-by: `session_01LvwGppdonww4zGLWZo5rho` (`domain:spec` execution seat 1) — a governed-surface and PM-tooling finding for the `skills` lane; ⛔ not graded, prioritised or dispatched by this seat, and ⛔ neither text was edited.
